package wrongreadhook

import (
	"example.com/ridu-gate1/field"
	"example.com/ridu-gate1/operation"
)

var _ = field.Relationship("owner", "users").ReadHooks(field.ReadHooks[operation.ReferenceOutput]{
	AfterRead: []field.OutputTransform[operation.ReferenceOutput]{
		func(operation.ReadContext, operation.Value[operation.ID]) (operation.Change[operation.ID], error) {
			return operation.Change[operation.ID]{}, nil
		},
	},
})
